inbox_specs.title: Beginner difficulty preset
inbox_specs.description: The Beginner preset fixes the board at 9 rows by 9 columns with 10 mines.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given the difficulty presets are available When the player selects Beginner Then the new game board has 9 rows, 9 columns and 10 mines

inbox_specs.title: Intermediate difficulty preset
inbox_specs.description: The Intermediate preset fixes the board at 16 rows by 16 columns with 40 mines.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given the difficulty presets are available When the player selects Intermediate Then the new game board has 16 rows, 16 columns and 40 mines

inbox_specs.title: Expert difficulty preset
inbox_specs.description: The Expert preset fixes the board at 30 columns by 16 rows with 99 mines.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given the difficulty presets are available When the player selects Expert Then the new game board has 16 rows, 30 columns and 99 mines

inbox_specs.title: Board size and mine count fixed for the session
inbox_specs.description: The difficulty fixes rows, columns and mine count for the whole game session. No action changes them.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a game session is in progress at Expert difficulty When any board action is attempted Then the session rows, columns and mine count remain 16, 30 and 99

inbox_specs.title: New session starts in Ready state
inbox_specs.description: A newly created game session has no reveal yet, so it is in the Ready state with zero elapsed time.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given the player has chosen a difficulty When a new game is started Then the session status is ready and elapsed_seconds is 0

inbox_specs.title: Mines placed after first reveal
inbox_specs.description: Mines are not placed when the game starts. They are placed at random on the first reveal, and that reveal moves the session to In progress.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session in Ready state with no mines placed When the player reveals a hidden cell for the first time Then mines are placed at random and the session status becomes in-progress

inbox_specs.title: First revealed cell is never a mine
inbox_specs.description: The cell revealed first is excluded from mine placement, so the first reveal can never trigger a loss.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session in Ready state When the player reveals cell (r, c) first Then cell (r, c) has has_mine false

inbox_specs.title: Exact mine count placed
inbox_specs.description: Exactly the difficulty's mine count is placed on the board, on distinct cells.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session with mine_count M is placed after the first reveal Then exactly M cells have has_mine true

inbox_specs.title: Adjacency count of a safe cell
inbox_specs.description: A safe cell's adjacent_mine_count equals the number of mines among its eight neighbours.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a safe cell with exactly K mines among its eight neighbours When mines are placed Then the cell's adjacent_mine_count is K, where 0 <= K <= 8

inbox_specs.title: Edge and corner cells count only existing neighbours
inbox_specs.description: For edge and corner cells, only neighbours that exist on the board are counted.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a corner cell with 2 neighbours that are mines and 1 neighbour that is safe When adjacency is computed Then the cell's adjacent_mine_count is 2

inbox_specs.title: Zero count displays blank
inbox_specs.description: A safe cell with an adjacency count of zero is shown as blank rather than as the number 0.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a revealed safe cell with adjacent_mine_count 0 When the board is displayed Then the cell is shown blank

inbox_specs.title: Reveal a hidden unflagged cell
inbox_specs.description: The player may reveal a hidden cell that is not flagged. The cell becomes revealed.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a hidden unflagged cell in a session in progress When the player reveals the cell Then the cell state becomes revealed

inbox_specs.title: Flagged cell cannot be revealed
inbox_specs.description: A flagged cell must be unflagged before it can be revealed. A reveal on a flagged cell is ignored.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a flagged cell When the player attempts to reveal the cell Then the cell state remains flagged and nothing else changes

inbox_specs.title: Revealed cell cannot be revealed again
inbox_specs.description: Revealed is a terminal cell state. Revealing an already revealed cell is ignored.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a revealed cell When the player attempts to reveal the cell again Then the cell state remains revealed and the timer is unaffected

inbox_specs.title: Revealing a mine loses the game
inbox_specs.description: Revealing a mine ends the session as lost and stops the timer.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session in progress and a hidden unflagged cell with has_mine true When the player reveals the cell Then the session status becomes lost and ended_at is recorded

inbox_specs.title: Zero-count reveal spreads to neighbours
inbox_specs.description: Revealing a safe cell with adjacency count zero also reveals all of its neighbours.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a hidden unflagged safe cell with adjacent_mine_count 0 When the player reveals the cell Then all eight neighbours that exist become revealed

inbox_specs.title: Spread repeats through connected zeros and stops at numbers
inbox_specs.description: The spread continues through every connected zero-count cell. Numbered cells are revealed but do not spread further.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a connected region of zero-count cells bordered by numbered cells When a zero-count cell in the region is revealed Then every cell in the region and its bordering numbered cells are revealed, and the numbered cells do not reveal their own neighbours

inbox_specs.title: Spread skips flagged cells
inbox_specs.description: A flagged cell cannot be revealed, so the spread leaves flagged cells hidden.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a zero-count cell next to a flagged cell When the zero-count cell is revealed Then the flagged cell remains flagged

inbox_specs.title: Toggle a flag on a hidden cell
inbox_specs.description: The player toggles a flag on a hidden cell. Flagging changes hidden to flagged and unflagging changes flagged back to hidden.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a hidden cell When the player toggles the flag Then the cell state becomes flagged, and toggling again returns the cell state to hidden

inbox_specs.title: Revealed cell cannot be flagged
inbox_specs.description: Flagging applies only to hidden cells. A flag action on a revealed cell is ignored.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a revealed cell When the player toggles a flag on the cell Then the cell state remains revealed and the flag count is unchanged

inbox_specs.title: Flags do not reveal cells
inbox_specs.description: Placing a flag changes only the flagged cell and reveals nothing else.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a hidden cell next to a zero-count cell When the player flags the hidden cell Then no other cell changes state

inbox_specs.title: Flagging before first reveal keeps session in Ready
inbox_specs.description: Flags may be placed while the session is Ready. A flag does not start the timer or move the session to In progress.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session in Ready state When the player flags a hidden cell Then the session status remains ready and elapsed_seconds stays 0

inbox_specs.title: Win when every safe cell is revealed
inbox_specs.description: The game is won when all safe cells are revealed. Mines remain hidden or flagged and do not block the win.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session in progress where the last hidden safe cell is revealed When the reveal completes Then the session status becomes won and ended_at is recorded

inbox_specs.title: Win does not require flags
inbox_specs.description: A win depends only on revealed safe cells. Flags are not checked.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session in progress where all safe cells are revealed and no mine cell is flagged When the last safe cell is revealed Then the session status becomes won

inbox_specs.title: Loss exposes all mines
inbox_specs.description: When the game is lost, every mine on the board is exposed to the player.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session that has just been lost When the board is finalised Then every cell with has_mine true is exposed to the player

inbox_specs.title: Loss display of mines and wrong flags
inbox_specs.description: On a loss, mines show as black dots and wrongly placed flags are marked.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session that is lost When the board is displayed Then mine cells show black dots and flagged cells without a mine show a wrong-flag marker

inbox_specs.title: Abandon a game at any time
inbox_specs.description: The player may abandon an unfinished game at any time to start a new board at the same difficulty. An abandoned game has no result.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session in Ready or in progress When the player abandons the game Then the session status becomes abandoned with no win or loss result and a new board is created at the same difficulty

inbox_specs.title: Timer starts at first reveal
inbox_specs.description: The elapsed timer starts when the first cell is revealed, not when the game is created or when a flag is placed.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session in Ready state When the player reveals the first cell Then started_at is recorded and the timer begins counting

inbox_specs.title: Timer shows whole seconds
inbox_specs.description: The timer displays elapsed time as whole seconds.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session in progress for 75.6 seconds When the timer is displayed Then it shows 75

inbox_specs.title: Timer stops on win or loss
inbox_specs.description: The timer stops when the game is won or lost and does not advance afterwards.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session that has just been won or lost with elapsed_seconds 120 When time passes Then elapsed_seconds remains 120

inbox_specs.title: New game returns to Ready
inbox_specs.description: Starting a new game resets all cells to hidden, clears mines and flags, resets the timer and returns the session to Ready.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session that is won, lost or abandoned When the player starts a new game Then the status is ready, all cells are hidden, flag_count is 0 and elapsed_seconds is 0

inbox_specs.title: Session status transitions
inbox_specs.description: The session moves Ready to In progress on first reveal, then to Won or Lost. Won and Lost are terminal, and only a new game returns the session to Ready.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session that is won or lost When any action other than starting a new game is attempted Then the status remains won or lost

inbox_specs.title: Cell state transitions
inbox_specs.description: A cell moves Hidden to Revealed (terminal), and between Hidden and Flagged. A flagged cell cannot move directly to Revealed.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a flagged cell When a reveal is attempted Then the cell does not move to revealed, and given a revealed cell When any flag action is attempted Then the cell does not move to flagged

inbox_specs.title: Mine counter equals mines minus flags
inbox_specs.description: The mine counter shown to the player is the mine count minus the number of flags placed.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session with 10 mines and 3 flagged cells When the mine counter is read Then it shows 7

inbox_specs.title: Mine counter may go negative
inbox_specs.description: The mine counter is not clamped. It goes negative when the player places more flags than there are mines.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session with 10 mines and 12 flagged cells When the mine counter is read Then it shows -2

inbox_specs.title: Board actions after game end are ignored
inbox_specs.description: After a game is won, lost or abandoned, reveal and flag actions are ignored. They change no cell state and do not affect the timer.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session that is won or lost When the player reveals or flags any cell Then no cell state changes and elapsed_seconds is unchanged

inbox_specs.title: Input controls for reveal and flag
inbox_specs.description: Click or tap reveals a cell. Right-click or long-press toggles a flag.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a hidden cell on the board When the player clicks or taps the cell Then a reveal is requested, and when the player right-clicks or long-presses the cell Then a flag toggle is requested

inbox_specs.title: Board tile appearance
inbox_specs.description: Hidden tiles look like grey raised tiles. Revealed tiles are flat light grey with numbers coloured as in classic Minesweeper: 1 blue, 2 green, 3 red, 4 dark blue.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a hidden cell and a revealed cell with count 2 When the board is displayed Then the hidden cell is a grey raised tile and the revealed cell is flat light grey with its number in green

inbox_specs.title: Flag marker appearance
inbox_specs.description: Flagged cells show a red flag.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a flagged cell When the board is displayed Then the cell shows a red flag marker

inbox_specs.title: Top bar layout
inbox_specs.description: The top bar shows the mine counter on the left, the status button in the centre and the timer on the right.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a game session is displayed When the top bar is rendered Then the mine counter is at the left, the status button in the centre and the timer at the right

inbox_specs.title: Status button face reflects game status
inbox_specs.description: The status button shows a smiley face during play, a loss face when the game is lost and a win face when the game is won.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given a session that is in progress When the status button is displayed Then it shows the smiley face, and given a session that is lost Then it shows the loss face

inbox_specs.title: Single player persona only
inbox_specs.description: The interface offers only the player role. No other roles appear.
inbox_specs.given_when_then: Given the game interface is open When the player views the screen Then no other user roles or role-specific controls are shown

intent.audience: players who want to play a single-player minesweeper puzzle
intent.primary_goal: Let a player reveal cells on a hidden minefield without triggering a mine, using the classic rules, and win by clearing all safe cells.
intent.scope_summary: A playable minesweeper board with cell state, mine placement, adjacency counts, flagging, and win/lose detection.
model_focus: board grid and cell states (hidden, revealed, flagged)
game session status (in progress, won, lost) and elapsed time
difficulty settings that define board size and mine count
assumptions: The game is single-player and runs locally or in a browser without a backend.
Classic minesweeper rules apply, including first-click safety only if it is part of the chosen variant.

spec_conflicts.reason: SPEC-016 requires every existing neighbour of a revealed zero-count cell to become revealed, while SPEC-018 requires a flagged neighbour to remain flagged when such a cell is revealed.
